# Flutter Background Video Recorder
A Flutter plugin for Android that enables video recording in the background.

## Overview
This plugin allows you to seamlessly record videos in your Android app, even when the app is running in the background, the screen is turned off, or the device is locked.

## Features (Android)
Compatible with Android API 28 (Pie) and later
Supports video and audio recording in Full HD (1080p)
Recording persists even if the app is minimized or terminated
Continues recording with the screen off or locked
Works with both front and rear cameras

## Planned Features
Audio-only recording
Camera preview functionality when the app is in the foreground
Flashlight support during video recording

## iOS Support
This plugin is currently not available for iOS. Contributions to make it compatible with iOS are welcome!

We encourage contributions, feature requests, and feedback to improve this package.

For implementation details, refer to the example provided.
